purpose: Help GPs decide whether WMC is a suitable practice — employer brand decision page, not a recruitment website.

accessibility.recommendation: Use header, main, nav, and footer landmarks; keep a single H1 in the hero.
Retain skip link to #main; ensure main is focusable (tabindex=-1) for skip target.
Keep visible focus-visible rings on links, buttons and FAQ summaries; minimum 44px touch targets.
Prefer native details/summary for FAQ; keep visible answer text identical to FAQPage schema.
Do not rely on colour alone for AGPAL/trust — keep the word Accredited in text.
Use descriptive CTAs such as Express interest with the practice — avoid Click here / Apply now agency tone.
No essential information in animation; respect prefers-reduced-motion if motion is added later.
Hero image needs meaningful alt describing the clinical environment; decorative images use empty alt.

schema.recommendation: FAQPage for decision FAQs; sync DOM text with JSON-LD acceptedAnswer text.
BreadcrumbList Home → About Us → Join Our Team.
Do not emit JobPosting, JobBoard, Occupation, or EmploymentAgency on this page.
Active JobPosting belongs only on Join Our Team when CMS injects a live vacancy.

copyGuards: No talent community / pipeline / we’re hiring agency language
No public percentage or earnings claims
Explicit: practice does not issue Medicare provider numbers
Frame as suitability decision, not a careers marketplace
